title: [FEAT]: Migrate Ingestion Watcher from Polling to Horizon Server-Sent Events (SSE) Stream
summary: Replace 10-second DB polling loop in watcher worker with Horizon SSE stream.
background: Current watcher queries Horizon API on a set interval, introducing up to 10s latency.
problemStatement: Polling creates unnecessary HTTP overhead on Horizon server and delays payment notification delivery.
proposedSolution: Refactor watcher worker to utilize server.payments().forAccount(key).cursor('now').stream() with reconnect logic.
acceptanceCriteria: Payments trigger ingestion immediately (<500ms) upon ledger closing
SSE stream automatically reconnects after network disconnects
testingRequirements: Simulate network drop and verify stream reconnect

title: [FEAT]: Implement Persistent Cursor Tracking Table in Prisma Schema
summary: Store last processed Horizon operation paging token per account in database.
background: Watcher starts from current state on boot, risking missed payments during worker downtime.
problemStatement: Worker restarts create transaction ingestion gaps.
proposedSolution: Create IngestionCursor model in schema.prisma and load cursor token on watcher boot.
acceptanceCriteria: IngestionCursor record created per wallet
Watcher resumes from exact cursor after restart

title: [FEAT]: Build Multi-Asset Balance & Soroban Asset Contract (SAC) Decoders
summary: Decode Soroban SAC token transfers and custom asset payment operations.
background: Stellar ecosystem relies heavily on SAC tokens like USDC and PYUSD.
problemStatement: Current parser extracts basic XLM native assets only.
proposedSolution: Add helper to parse SAC transfer events and Horizon custom asset codes.
acceptanceCriteria: Custom SAC tokens correctly parsed with decimals
Asset code and issuer address recorded in DB
testingRequirements: Unit test SAC topic decoding logic

title: [SEC]: Add Request Rate Limiting Middleware (@fastify/rate-limit)
summary: Register rate limiting on Fastify API endpoints.
background: API endpoints currently lack rate limiting.
problemStatement: Backend is vulnerable to brute force and DDoS attacks.
proposedSolution: Register @fastify/rate-limit plugin in app.ts with 100 req/min threshold.
acceptanceCriteria: Exceeding rate limit returns HTTP 429
Retry-After header included in response

title: [FEAT]: Implement Webhook Alert Endpoint Management API
summary: Build REST CRUD endpoints for user-registered webhook URLs.
background: Users need custom webhook triggers for incoming payments.
problemStatement: No endpoints exist to register or manage webhook targets.
proposedSolution: Create /webhooks routes (POST, GET, DELETE, POST /:id/test).
acceptanceCriteria: Users can add, list, and delete custom webhook URLs
Test endpoint dispatches ping payload

title: [DX]: Integrate Fastify Swagger & Scalar for OpenAPI Interactive Docs
summary: Auto-generate interactive Swagger/OpenAPI documentation at /docs.
background: Reviewers and developers require interactive API documentation.
problemStatement: No OpenAPI specification is currently exposed.
proposedSolution: Register @fastify/swagger and @fastify/swagger-ui plugins.
acceptanceCriteria: Navigating to /docs renders interactive API documentation
Zod schemas exported into OpenAPI component schemas

title: [SEC]: Enforce Strict CORS Origin Controls and Security Headers
summary: Configure @fastify/cors and @fastify/helmet security headers.
background: API requires strict browser security policies.
problemStatement: Wildcard CORS headers allow unauthorized origins.
proposedSolution: Configure CORS whitelist matching APP_URL env variable.
acceptanceCriteria: Preflight OPTIONS requests return correct CORS origin
testingRequirements: Verify preflight headers in unit tests

title: [DB]: Configure PostgreSQL Read Replicas & Connection Pooling
summary: Optimize Prisma Client connection pooling parameters.
background: High concurrent watcher queries require efficient pooling.
problemStatement: Database connection exhaustion under high transaction volume.
proposedSolution: Set connection_limit and pool_timeout in DATABASE_URL.
acceptanceCriteria: Prisma pool handles 50 concurrent watcher queries

title: [FEAT]: Soroban RPC Contract Event Parser Integration
summary: Parse Soroban smart contract event logs via RPC getEvents query.
background: Soroban smart contracts emit topic event logs instead of standard operations.
problemStatement: Contract payments are missed by Horizon operations watcher.
proposedSolution: Implement Soroban RPC getEvents client and event topic decoder in soroban.ts.
acceptanceCriteria: Contract transfer events decoded and stored in Payment table

title: [FEAT]: BullMQ Redis Alert Queue & Asynchronous Message Dispatcher
summary: Build BullMQ payment-alerts Redis queue with exponential retries.
background: Notification dispatches must not block Horizon ingestion thread.
problemStatement: Synchronous webhook dispatches delay transaction processing.
proposedSolution: Instantiate BullMQ queue and worker in apps/api/src/lib/queue.ts.
acceptanceCriteria: Alert jobs enqueued upon transaction insertion with 5 retry attempts

title: [SEC]: HMAC SHA256 Webhook Payload Cryptographic Signer
summary: Sign outgoing webhook payloads with HMAC SHA256 signatures.
background: Receiving webhooks require signature verification to prevent spoofing.
problemStatement: Webhooks currently lack cryptographic origin authentication.
proposedSolution: Build signWebhookPayload function adding X-Stellar-Alerts-Signature header.
acceptanceCriteria: X-Stellar-Alerts-Signature header generated via HMAC SHA256
testingRequirements: Unit test signature generation and verification

title: [SEC]: Base32 CRC16-XMODEM StrKey Public Key Validation Guard
summary: Validate Ed25519 public key checksums using StellarSdk.StrKey.
background: Invalid checksum public keys cause Horizon API 400 Bad Request errors.
problemStatement: Invalid checksum string keys corrupt watcher loop.
proposedSolution: Add StellarSdk.StrKey.isValidEd25519PublicKey check in Zod schema and watcher.
acceptanceCriteria: Invalid public keys rejected with HTTP 400 before DB write
testingRequirements: Unit test valid and invalid StrKey strings

title: [SEC]: Single-Use Token Invalidation & Expiration Guard for Magic Links
summary: Enforce single-use token consumption for passwordless login.
background: Magic tokens must expire immediately after verification.
problemStatement: Replay attacks possible if magic links remain valid.
proposedSolution: Store token jti in Redis and delete on first verification.
acceptanceCriteria: Magic token returns 401 Unauthorized on second attempt

title: [SEC]: JWT Session Token Revocation & Redis Blocklist
summary: Implement session token revocation via Redis blocklist.
background: Users need ability to log out and revoke sessions.
problemStatement: Stateless JWTs cannot be invalidated before expiration.
proposedSolution: Check token jti against Redis blocklist in auth.middleware.ts.
acceptanceCriteria: Logged out JWTs rejected with 401

title: [FEAT]: Payment Aggregate Volume & Statistics REST Endpoints

acceptanceCriteria: GET /payments/summary returns total Volume and Count

acceptanceCriteria: Returns 200 OK if all 3 services respond, 503 if down

title: [DX]: Structured Pino Logging with Correlation IDs (x-request-id)

acceptanceCriteria: All logs contain reqId field matching HTTP header

title: [RELIABILITY]: Graceful Process Shutdown Handler for API and Watcher
summary: Handle SIGTERM and SIGINT signals gracefully.
background: Container restarts terminate active worker connections abruptly.
problemStatement: Ungraceful shutdowns corrupt active SSE streams.
proposedSolution: Close Fastify server and Prisma connection on process signal.
acceptanceCriteria: Process closes active handles within 5s of SIGTERM
testingRequirements: Send SIGTERM to process and verify clean exit

title: [DB]: Database Connection Retry Strategy with Exponential Backoff
summary: Retry database connections on transient boot failure.
background: Container boot order can cause premature DB connection failures.
problemStatement: API crashes immediately if Postgres takes 2s longer to boot.
proposedSolution: Wrap Prisma $connect in exponential backoff retry loop.
acceptanceCriteria: App retries 5 times before exiting on DB connection failure

title: [RELIABILITY]: Horizon SSE Stream Heartbeat & Auto-Reconnect Fallback
summary: Detect silent SSE stream drops using a 30s heartbeat timer.
background: Silent TCP stream drops leave watcher in stale state.
problemStatement: Worker stops receiving events without throwing error.
proposedSolution: Reset heartbeat timer on every SSE chunk; reconnect if timer expires.
acceptanceCriteria: Watcher reconnects SSE stream if no chunk received for 60s

title: [RELIABILITY]: Dead Letter Queue (DLQ) for Failed Notification Dispatches
summary: Route notification jobs to DLQ after 5 failed attempts.
background: Permanently failing webhooks clog queue retry pipeline.
problemStatement: Retrying dead webhooks indefinitely wastes system resources.
proposedSolution: Configure BullMQ deadLetterQueue option.
acceptanceCriteria: Failed jobs moved to DLQ table after 5 retries

title: [DB]: Payment Table txHash Unique Constraint Index Optimization
summary: Add B-tree index on txHash and receivedAt columns.
background: Deduplication queries require fast lookup.
problemStatement: Table scans slow down payment insertion as row count grows.
proposedSolution: Add @@index([txHash]) and @@index([receivedAt]) in schema.prisma.
acceptanceCriteria: Index exists in PostgreSQL schema

title: [FEAT]: Webhook Delivery Audit Log Persistence
